body:
maya: FYI we surfaced a delayed object publish affecting legacy aggregates for 2026-03-14 03:30-04:45 UTC. daily counts are off for a handful of clients. Need a scoped replay + clear console UX for cost estimates.

zoe: can we limit to specific partitions? which ingestion shards are affected?

maya: shards 4, 5, and 8. total estimated rows ~110k but many should dedupe.

dan: full backfill would hit our replayer CPU and the Dedicated slot quota. prefer a small targeted run with dedupe and preflight confirmation.

leah: agree. console should show per-shard token estimate, expected duplicate removal, and an "allow quota bump" toggle with an explanation. ops wants a one-click dry-run.

ryan: our preflight endpoint exists (POST /api/replay/preflight) but it returns only row counts. we'll extend it to return token_estimate and slot_seconds. low effort.

maya: proposed flow: (1) call preflight for shards 4,5,8 (2) dry-run to calculate id collisions (3) run replay with --dedupe and quota_override if needed. route policy should allow fallback to standard pool.

zoe: note: fallback currently strips X-Idempotency-Key. that causes duplicate writes when route falls back. we should ensure header passthrough.

ryan: acknowledged. I'll add middleware to copy X-Idempotency-Key on fallback paths. small PR.

dan: ops ask: when we allow quota_override, the console must render the impact on Dedicated pool (e.g. 40% of burst capacity) and require explicit approval from on-call.

ops-bot: preflight scheduled by maya at 1757012360. command: `/replayer preflight --shards 4,5,8 --since 2026-03-14T03:30Z --until 2026-03-14T04:45Z`

maya: add runbook step: if preflight tokens > 60k escalate to infra lead.

ops-bot: preflight result: shards 4->12.5k, 5->10.1k, 8->8.6k; token_estimate_total=31.2k; expected duplicates ~2.1k. slot_seconds estimate=420s.

leah: that's within soft limits. UX: we'll show the numbers and a toggle for quota_override up to 35k tokens. confirmation modal will require typing the shard ids.

zoe: I'll run a dry-run now: `/replayer run --shards 4,5,8 --mode dry-run --since 2026-03-14T03:30Z --until 2026-03-14T04:45Z`

ops-bot: dry-run complete (1757012390). duplicates_found=2,073. token_estimate=31,180. schema_validation=ok.

dan: good. schedule actual replay in 15m during maintenance window. Sam on-call? (ping @oncall)

maya: sam is on-call today but not online yet. I can hold until they approve override.

ryan: reminder: ensure replay job sets header X-Idempotency-Key and that the router preserves it across fallback. PR in flight.

ops-bot: replay job queued by zoe (scheduled start 1757012460). command: `/replayer run --shards 4,5,8 --since 2026-03-14T03:30Z --until 2026-03-14T04:45Z --dedupe --quota-override 35k`

leah: watching dashboards: per-shard token burn, replayer CPU, and route fallbacks. will call out if any lane fills up.

ops-bot: replay started (job id r-20260314-990). routing policy: low-latency -> fallback standard.

zoe: mid-run update: one shard (5) hit a transient network error causing a few retries but fallback preserved idempotency header. no duplicates.

dan: that's exactly why we need header passthrough. good catch.

ops-bot: job finished (1757012425). tokens_used=30,980; duplicates_removed=2,052; no SLO violations recorded.

maya: thanks all. followups: (1) console preflight UX mock + confirmation modal (leah), (2) router middleware PR for idempotency header (ryan), (3) add a one-line handoff checklist to the runbook (maya).

leah: I'll post the mock in ~45m. will include checkbox for "alert infra lead if >60k tokens".

ryan: PR opened for header passthrough, small tests included.

maya: closing thread  filing a short note in #postmortems if infra lead wants details. great teamwork. :tada:
